baseline_note: ESTGCN = faithful reimplementation of the E-STGCN architecture family (Chebyshev-GCN + LSTM + POT, arXiv:2411.12258), not the authors' code. The fair-mode adjacency recompute is deliberately disabled to show the static-adjacency limitation.
scenario: sensors drop OFFLINE at inference (30%/50%); fixed N_train adjacency cannot message-pass over the reduced node set; OmniST runs on the same set and holds coverage.
